news.headline: U.S. payrolls surprise lifts Fed‑hike odds
news.body: U.S. nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly rose by 162,000 in August, pushing Treasury yields higher and prompting markets to reassess Federal Reserve policy. Markets now place a noticeably larger chance on a rate increase at the Fed meeting scheduled for Sept. 15-16, 2026.

footerNote: All times converted from official kickoffs
